text:
lina: FYI - Violet Labs onboarding hit a 95th tail latency regression after yesterday's model rollout. Observed 95p ~2.6s (baseline ~1.1s). They’re on hosted with a steady mix of short chat prompts + a few long context binds. Thinking proactive: small canary that switches routing to a compact int4 model + tweak batching and enable prefix cache. Need SE + SRE signoff before we touch their routes.

mike: Can you paste the dashboard link and a quick breakdown of the request shapes? short vs long, token counts, p95 by endpoint.

lina: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/violetlabs/onboard-latency
lina: TL;DR: 78% short (<80 tokens) chat-completions, 20% medium (80-512), 2% >512. Spike correlates with increased concurrency from a new integration. No error rate increase.

ryan: Sounds like a classic batching vs model-size tradeoff. Proposal: 1) Canary route (5%) to compact-int4 variant, 2) enable prefix/KV cache for the short chat route, 3) momentarily lower max_batch_wait_ms for the short route to keep latency predictable. We can auto-fall back if p95 worsens.

parth: Quick risk table:
- Model swap: risk = small semantic drift on edge cases (low), mitigation = rolling canary + eval set.
- Cache enablement: risk = stale prefix if they use dynamic system prompts (medium), mitigation = short TTL + instrument mismatches.
- Batching tweaks: risk = lower throughput (medium), mitigation = autoscale burst + monitor.

lina: Agree with that. I can run the canary and own comms to the customer. SEs: mike + ryan, can you prepare the config snippet? I'll get the eval prompt set ready.

mike: Config draft below for the route canary. We should also nudge their client to add a small client-side retry to smooth transient tails.

```yaml
route: /v1/chat/completions
canary_percent: 5
model: redwood-compact-13b-int4
route_overrides:
  batching:
    max_batch_wait_ms: 6
    max_batch_tokens: 2048
  cache:
    prefix_cache: true
    ttl_ms: 30000
```

mike: Also add a lightweight eval pair set (10 prompts) that covers their critical flows. If the BLEU/ROUGE-like score drops >2% we abort.

ryan: I’ll add an autoscale guard to the Dedicated pool and a fallback policy to route back to the original model on 3 consecutive p95 breaches. Deploy-bot, please schedule the canary window at 10:15 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: start=4991240400 (10:15 UTC), duration=20m, route=/v1/chat/completions, percent=5, owner=lina. Use command: `/canary start --route /v1/chat/completions --model redwood-compact-13b-int4 --percent 5 --duration 20m`

lina: Perfect. I'll post a short note to Violet Labs: "We’ll run a 20m canary at 10:15 UTC to test a compact model + caching tweak; no expected downtime; we’ll share results asap." Will also attach the eval set. :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup: I’ll monitor p95 and the eval set metrics. If anything odd, call it out in this thread and we’ll abort.

ryan: :ok_hand: One ask — enable tracing on their top 3 endpoints for the canary so we can correlate KV hits.

lina: Done. I’ll update with canary results within 30m after completion. Thanks team.
